# mtncloud_storage_buckets (Data Source)

Lists your storage buckets, including those made in the console. Storage buckets (for example on MOS) used for backups and images. Their access keys are never read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_storage_buckets" "all" {}

output "storage_buckets" {
  value = { for x in data.mtncloud_storage_buckets.all.storage_buckets : x.id => { name = x.name, bucket_name = x.bucket_name } }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_regex` (String) Only return storage buckets whose name matches this regular expression (RE2 syntax), for example `^web-`.

### Read-Only

- `storage_buckets` (Attributes List) The storage buckets, sorted by name, then ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_buckets))

<a id="nestedatt--storage_buckets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `storage_buckets`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether it is active.
- `bucket_name` (String) Bucket name on the storage server.
- `id` (Number) ID of the storage bucket.
- `name` (String) Name of the storage bucket.
- `provider_type` (String) Storage type, for example `s3` for S3-compatible storage.
- `read_only` (Boolean) Whether it is read-only.
